data: What is the size of the blue line when the number of keywords is 500, in the rightmost plot?

The question asks for the size of the blue line when the number of keywords is 500, in the rightmost plot. The blue line represents the graph size. From the caption, we know that the x-axis represents the number of keywords. In the rightmost plot, the x-axis ranges from 100 to 1000. The y-axis represents the size in MB. The blue line starts at approximately 600 MB and increases as the number of keywords increases. At 500 keywords, the blue line is slightly above 1000 MB. Therefore, the size of the blue line when the number of keywords is 500 is approximately 1000 MB.
